sources.title: OneScience-Group/Saluki · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Saluki Model Introduction Saluki is a deep learning model for predicting mammalian mRNA half-life. The model takes full-length mRNA sequences as input and jointly encodes the first codon frame and splice-site information. It uses convolutional neural networks and gated recurrent units to learn sequence features associated with mRNA stability.
